children.name: Mia
children.description: older girl, long curly hair (green top on Saturday, yellow dress on Sunday)

children.name: Leo
children.description: boy, short hair (navy t-shirt on Saturday, patterned shirt on Sunday)

children.name: Noah
children.description: toddler (navy top or white shirt), often held or in a high chair

say.text: Hey everyone, welcome back to the kitchen! Today we're making a big Saturday breakfast.
Leo is in charge of grapes today, and he takes that job very seriously.
Mia picked every single berry in this bowl herself, and she wants you to know it.
Our kitchen rule: grown-ups slice, kids arrange.
And here's Noah, our tiniest taste tester. He mostly eats the blueberries.
While the pancakes cook, a quick thank you to today's sponsor, Sunny Oats.
Everyone gets a seat at the table.
Mia says she'll do the dishes. We'll see about that.
Thanks for hanging out with us. See you next Saturday!
It's Sunday, and that means homemade lunch.
Leo and Mia are on salad duty.
Noah is making his very first sandwich today. He's been practising all week.

segments.notes: Mia is small and partly hidden in the background

say.text: He did it! One slightly squashed sandwich.
Thanks to our sponsor, Green Crate.
Today I'm reviewing the new Brightblend blender, and honestly, I'm impressed.
It has six speeds, a glass jug, and it is surprisingly quiet.
The smoothie test was a big hit. Leo asked for seconds.
Use my code for ten percent off. The link is in the description.
